notes.purpose: M16 step 4: R = 30 traffic uncertainty draws per (topology, scale), every method solved on the same draw (05 §2, paired).
notes.scales: 9 log-spaced points, 10^-2 .. 10^2, step 10^0.5; s = 1 is exact. M15 found NO crossover anywhere in that range on T1-T3, so there is no narrower crossover region to span and the M15 range is reused unchanged (D-067).
notes.scale_definition: multiplies every inter-component edge volume; internet egress unchanged (03 §S9, same as M15).
notes.b1_alt: B1 with the opposite final tie-break (D-039); H1 is reported against both B1 variants.
notes.draws: seed = 10,000 + draw_id (05 §3); T1 resamples the M07 measurements, T2/T3 use the stated lognormal model.

notes.runs.csv: one row per (instance, method, seed); standard columns (01 §4) first; appended as each job finishes; resume skips present keys.
notes.runtime_s: method wall time; ILP = build + CBC; greedy_1opt includes greedy.
notes.status: optimal (ILP proven) | feasible (ILP incumbent, not proven) | no_solution | ok (heuristic or baseline)
